paper.title_en: Helicity amplitudes and angular distributions in $D\to b_1(1235)(\toωπ)\ell^+ν_\ell$
paper.abstract_en: Using the helicity amplitude technique, we derive the decay intensity for the charmed meson semileptonic decays $D\to b_1(1235)\ell^+ν_\ell, b_1(1235)\toωπ$ with $\ell=e,μ$. Based on the theoretically predicted hadronic transition form factors, the branching fractions for $D^0\to b_1(1235)^-\ell^+ν_\ell$ and their lepton flavor universality ratios are calculated. The predicted branching fractions of the positronic channel span $(2.6$--$8.8)\times10^{-5}$, with most theoretical predictions being consistent with the previous BESIII measurement $(7.2\pm1.8^{+0.6}_{-0.8})\times10^{-5}$ by assuming $\mathcal{B}(b_1(1235)\toωπ)=1$. We further explore the partial decay widths and angular distributions of $D\to b_1(1235)\ell^+ν_\ell, b_1(1235)\toωπ$ and find distinct behavior among various hadronic transition form factors. Further amplitude analysis with larger statistics is thus desired to test these theoretical predictions.
